paper.note: Dark theme does not literally invert this value; it swaps to #142723, a tinted step toward forest rather than true black.

display.purpose: The hero <h1> only; the single heaviest line on the site (weight 540).

headline.purpose: Every other section heading and page <h1>; weight 500, size varies 2.5rem–6rem by section.

title.purpose: Step headings, row labels, the step-number numeral.

label.purpose: Spaced-caps map labels and captions (e.g. "You ask", the terrain credit line). A world-native device, not a banned eyebrow — never sits directly above a heading.

hand.purpose: Illustrative handwriting ink layer and the circled one-pen fallback glyph only. Never used as UI type.

shadows.name: paper-cast
shadows.value: 0 1-2px 2-4px rgba(near-black contact), 10-18px 16-26px 30-38px rgb(20 40 34 / 0.16) or rgb(1 14 13 / 0.5) cast
shadows.purpose: Every tilted paper/photo object: the hero's marked page, the cover/page-2 stack, the ink close-up, the next-page preview, the Showcase feature pane. Tight contact shadow + larger green-tinted cast shadow, never pure black.

motion.name: arrive
motion.purpose: Hero scene elements (ask bubble, reply card, photo label) arriving in sequence on load.

motion.name: reveal-trail
motion.purpose: The dashed ochre route drawing itself from request to page, then page to reply.

motion.name: write-in
motion.value: clip-path inset reveal, 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1), staggered per line via --i
motion.purpose: The hero's marked-page ink appearing to write itself in, line by line, once on load.

motion.name: reduced-motion-policy
motion.purpose: Hero.astro gates its sequence on no-preference; MarkedPage.astro explicitly zeroes the write-in animation under reduce. No shipped animation plays for a reduced-motion visitor.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled CTA on the site: Install Switchback.
components.html: Install Switchback
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2.2rem; min-height: 58px; padding: 0.85rem 1.3rem 0.85rem 1.4rem; color: #17221b; background: #d1a34b; border-radius: 3px; font: 600 1rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(1,16,15,0.32); transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary .ds-btn-arrow { width: 1.25em; height: 1.25em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e2b65f; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d1a34b; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Underlined text action, used for every non-primary CTA (e.g. See how it works).
components.html: See how it works
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.4rem 0; color: #f4f8f5; font: 600 1rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-decoration-color: rgba(244,248,245,0.5); } .ds-btn-secondary .ds-btn-arrow { width: 1.05em; height: 1.05em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: #d1a34b; text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d1a34b; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Step Number
components.description: The circular numeral marking each round-trip step, strung on the dashed ochre trail.
components.css: .ds-step-number { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 52px; height: 52px; border: 3px solid #d1a34b; border-radius: 50%; background: #f7f9f6; color: #111411; font: 500 1.45rem/1 Besley, Georgia, serif; }

components.name: Reply Card
components.description: The agent's paper-coloured reply card in the hero scene, with a red-tinted still-open row.
components.html:
Your blue question: answered first.

Still open: what's unresolved.
components.css: .ds-reply-card { border-radius: 8px 2px 8px 8px; background: #f7f9f6; color: #1d2a22; box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(1,14,13,0.38); } .ds-reply-card p { margin: 0; padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.48; } .ds-reply-card .ds-reply-open { border-top: 1px solid #dfe5de; color: #9a2c25; }

components.name: Chat Bubble (you)
components.description: A right-aligned sent-message bubble in the chat transcript, pulled-corner radius.
components.html:
You

Help me plan my talk, on paper.
components.css: .ds-chat-you { justify-self: end; max-width: 86%; } .ds-chat-who { margin: 0 0 0.45rem; color: #9fbab0; font: 600 0.7rem/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: right; } .ds-chat-say { margin: 0; padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 9px 9px 2px 9px; background: #1c4440; color: #e6efe9; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Pen Swatch
components.description: A hand-drawn ink stroke on a scrap of white paper, standing in for a flat colour swatch so it reads the same in both themes.
components.css: .ds-pen-swatch { display: inline-block; width: 64px; height: 30px; padding: 8px 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,40,34,0.18); overflow: visible; } .ds-pen-swatch path { fill: none; stroke: #2546b0; stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round; }

narrative.overview: The site is a topographic map of one real place — Sani Pass, Drakensberg — with the product's own loop (ask, print, mark, photograph, reply) drawn on top as a dashed ochre trail. The dark forest plateau is the screen you step away from; the white printed page, tilted and shadowed like paper actually left on a desk, is the object the whole page revolves around; the trail runs into it and back out to a reply card, so the visitor reads the loop rather than being told about it. Nothing on the page claims to be a tool landing page: there is no feature grid, no glyph-icon row, no eyebrow sitting above a heading. Headings carry the whole announcement themselves. Two materials never mix: the map (real terrain, trail-ochre, spaced-caps labels, Besley/Inter) and the page (white paper, black fineliner, pen-blue/pen-red/crux-yellow handwriting in Kalam). The map explains; the page is evidence. Everything photographic on the page is real; nothing is model-generated imagery.
keyCharacteristics: A dark, real-terrain plateau carries the pitch; a tilted white page is the hero's focal object, not an illustration beside it.
One accent (trail-ochre) marks the route and the one thing to click; everything else is forest-dark or paper-neutral.
Handwriting (Kalam) is scoped to exactly two places: the illustrative ink overlay and the one-pen circled-letter fallback. It never appears as UI type.
A single reveal-once sequence (ink writes itself in, then the reply arrives) plays on load and is fully suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.
No eyebrows above headings, no icon-font or glyph icons anywhere — every icon on the page is a hand-specified inline SVG path.

rules.name: The One Trail Rule
rules.body: Trail-ochre is the only saturated accent anywhere in the UI chrome. It marks a route or a single next action; it is never used for a large fill or a second competing accent.

rules.name: The Ink-Stays-On-Paper Rule
rules.body: Pen black/blue/red and crux yellow are drawn only inside the handwriting layer or its circled-letter fallback. They do not leak into buttons, links, or badges.

rules.name: The Variable-Weight Rule
rules.body: Besley is loaded as a variable font specifically so headings can sit at in-between weights (540 for the hero, 500 elsewhere) instead of snapping to 400/700.

rules.name: The Paper-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A cast shadow appears only under an object standing in for a physical sheet of paper or a chat panel. Flat UI stays shadowless; its depth comes from a background-colour step instead.

dos: Do keep trail-ochre rare: one route, one CTA, one highlight colour, never a secondary UI palette.
Do give every tilted paper object the two-layer paper-cast shadow (tight contact + soft green-tinted cast); don't substitute a generic drop shadow.
Do caption any handwriting or reply content that is authored rather than a real returned photo as "Illustrative example."
Do keep Kalam confined to the ink layer and its circled-letter fallback; it is a handwriting prop, not a UI typeface.
Do suppress every entrance/write-in animation under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Do draw icons as hand-specified inline SVG paths; never pull in an icon font or a Lucide/Heroicons-style glyph set.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow or kicker above a heading.
Don't reuse pen-blue, pen-red, or crux-yellow for ordinary UI state (links, errors, badges); those colours are reserved for handwritten meaning.

Don't add a new near-white text colour for a dark surface — the build already has an untokenized family of one-off light literals on dark backgrounds instead of one shared token; treat this as debt to consolidate, not a menu to add to.

Don't assume privacy.astro and changelog.astro's footer matches the home page's — their own styles leave footer text pale over plain paper background with no dark panel underneath, a shipped contrast inconsistency, not an intended two-tone footer.
